title: Write Vitest unit tests for the repository layer
description: Write Vitest unit tests for all repository functions in src/db/repository.ts. Use an in-memory SQLite database for test isolation.
acceptanceCriteria: All CRUD operations tested: createBatch, listBatches, getBatch, createProspects, getProspectsByBatch, getProspectBySlug, updateProspect, createMedia, upsertSetting, getSetting
Each test uses a fresh in-memory DB (beforeEach setup)

steps.details: Create `src/db/__tests__/testDb.ts`. Export `createTestDb()` that creates an in-memory SQLite DB, runs migrations, and returns the DB instance + repository functions.
Test: createBatch returns object with id and timestamps. listBatches returns all batches. getBatch returns correct batch by id. getBatch returns null for unknown id.
Test: createProspects inserts all and returns them. getProspectsByBatch filters correctly. getProspectBySlug finds by slug. updateProspect patches only specified fields.
Test: upsertSetting creates new setting. upsertSetting updates existing setting. getSetting returns null for unknown key.
Run `npm test`. All tests should pass. Fix any failures.
